name: DSP-16
description: RISC-16 with a hardware multiplier, the heart of a digital signal processor: MUL R0, R1, R2 multiplies two 8.8 fixed point numbers in one instruction, which is what it takes to draw the Mandelbrot set in colour.

programs.name: Mandelbrot, 80 x 60
programs.description: The whole set in 8 x 8 pixel blocks: minutes at full speed

programs.name: Mandelbrot, 160 x 120
programs.description: The same picture in 4 x 4 pixel blocks: four times the points

programs.name: Mandelbrot, 640 x 480
programs.description: Every pixel of the screen its own point: hours at full speed
